label: Pattern categories
description: Groups for browsing mechanic patterns in the library. When several fit, pick the first in this order: conversion, infiltration, transport and garrison, mode change, summon, stealth and deception, control, defence, support, area, mobility, progression, weapon behaviour. A pattern may list up to two more categories for filtering.

terms.label: Weapon behaviour
terms.description: How a weapon works: chaining, charging, beams, splitting, switching.

terms.label: Control
terms.description: Stops or hampers enemies: stun, root, silence, slow, freeze.

terms.label: Infiltration
terms.description: Gets inside enemy units or lines: infest, hijack, capture, steal.

terms.label: Stealth and deception
terms.description: Hides or fakes: cloak, disguise, decoy.

terms.label: Mobility
terms.description: Moves in special ways: leap, dash, teleport, burrow.

terms.label: Mode change
terms.description: Switches form or stance: deploy, siege, transform.

terms.label: Defence
terms.description: Survives in special ways: shields, barriers, armour tricks, self-repair.

terms.label: Support
terms.description: Helps teammates: heal, repair, buff, resupply.

terms.label: Transport and garrison
terms.description: Carries or houses others; passengers matter.

terms.label: Conversion
terms.description: Turns the enemy's strength into yours: leech, salvage, mind control.

terms.label: Area
terms.description: Shapes the ground: mines, zones, terrain.

terms.label: Progression
terms.description: Grows stronger during a life: veterancy, levels, kill streaks, stacking buffs.
